Subject: Urgent: Senior Platform Engineer req — coverage & interim plan

Team —

Quick context: Raj (Senior Platform Eng, infra serving runtime) gave notice last week; last day is 5/28. This role was already approved for H2, but we do not have a live req in ATS and the immediate hit to the platform team will be material during the June-QBR load. I need a rapid decision on:

1) Approve rolling the existing queued H2 req forward to immediate open and enable expedited recruiter fee (vendor/contingent) if needed.
2) Short-term coverage plan: hire a 3-month contractor via preferred vendor or pull a senior SWEs for a 6-week rotation.
3) Any cost/IR changes we need to sign off on for early fill (I attached the cost model and the formal req doc).

Ask: Can I get a yes/no on #1 and #2 by EOD today so recruiting can place vendor requests and we can post the req? If we can't hire headcount, we'll need to convert two senior ICs to rotations and accept 20% slowdown for a sprint or two; want to avoid that if possible.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
(Attached: brief req doc and cost worksheet)

Vivek —

Thanks for the heads-up. A few quick thoughts:

• I support opening the req now and prioritizing H2->H1 shift given the QBR risk.
• Need a cost delta approved from finance for any sign-on/expedited vendor fees; Markus, can you confirm runway?
• If we go contractor for 3 months, we should require knowledge transfer milestones (two runbooks + one shadow week) baked into the SOW.

Question: is this role EoP-sensitive (customer-facing code paths) or mostly internal infra? If customer-facing, I'd push for internal hire vs vendor. If internal, vendor is acceptable as a stopgap.

I can greenlight the rotation of two senior ICs for 6 weeks as a fallback, but want to limit the duration.

Laura

I reviewed the cost model. Finance will accept a one-time expedited hiring premium up to $18k for senior roles where business continuity risk is demonstrable; beyond that requires Director-level signoff. Given the QBR exposure you flagged, I am prepared to approve up to $18k on this req.

Actions I am initiating:
1) Routing to finance-approvals for a quick sign-off (cc'd). Expect approval within 24 hrs.
2) Authorizing recruiting to post as "Immediate - expedited" and to engage NimbusAI as a vendor for an initial shortlist.
3) Requesting a brief SOW template (recruiting) that includes the transfer milestones Laura asked for.

Please confirm if you want recruiting to prioritize on-site candidates (US-west) vs remote. If we go remote, we save ~12% on comp expectation but risk timezone friction for the platform on-call schedule.

-Markus
